title: 第20章 我没有儿子
novel_title: 莫欺老年穷，一天增加一个天赋点
content_zh:
雷云县南城。

    一处隶属于秃鹫帮的地下赌场内，乌烟瘴气，人声鼎沸。

    骰子碰撞的清脆声、赌徒们或狂喜或绝望的嘶吼声，交织成一曲混乱的交响乐。

    在一张最热闹的骰子桌前，一声暴喝猛然炸响！

    “抓住他！这狗日的出老千！”

    话音未落，几个膀大腰圆、满脸横肉的赌场打手便如饿虎扑食般扑了上去。

    面如金纸的陈龙，被两个壮汉死死按在地上，动弹不得。

    他藏在袖中的一枚灌了铅的特制骰子，骨碌碌地滚落到一旁，在灯火下闪着诡异的光。

    证据确凿。

    赌场管事，一个脸上带着狰狞刀疤的汉子，狞笑着走了过来。

    他一脚重重踩在陈龙的手背上，脚尖用力碾了碾。

    “咔嚓！”

    指骨碎裂的轻响，被赌场的喧嚣所淹没。

    “啊！！”

    陈龙发出杀猪般的惨嚎。

    “小子，敢在咱们秃鹫帮的地盘上耍花样，胆子不小啊。”刀疤管事吐了口唾沫，慢条斯理地说道，“按咱们这儿的规矩，出千被抓，剁手！”

    剁手两个字一出来。

    陈龙顿时吓得魂飞魄散，涕泪横流，也顾不上手上的剧痛，拼命地在地上磕头求饶：“好汉饶命！大爷饶命啊！我再也不敢了！我把赢的钱都还给你们，不，我身上所有的钱都给你们！”

    然而，刀疤管事不为所动。

    对于这种场面，他早已司空见惯。

    一把雪亮的板斧被一个打手高高举起，锋利的斧刃在灯火下反射出森然的寒光。

    死亡的阴影，瞬间笼罩了陈龙。

    在这极致的恐惧下，他爆发出了最后的求生欲望，脑中灵光一闪，嘶声尖叫起来：

    “别杀我！别杀我！我爹是陈安！风云镖局的陈安！他是你们惹不起的人！他是秦虎大当家的救命恩人！”

    “嗯？”

    那柄高高举起的板斧，在空中猛地一顿。

    整个嘈杂的角落，仿佛被按下了暂停键。

    刀疤管事脸上的狞笑僵住，眼中闪过一丝惊疑与忌惮。

    风云镖局，秦虎！
content_en:
Nancheng, Leiyun County.

    An underground casino belonging to the Vulture Gang was filled with smoke and bustling people.

    The crisp sound of the dice colliding and the gamblers' roars of ecstasy or despair intertwined into a chaotic symphony.

    In front of one of the liveliest dice tables, a loud shout suddenly exploded!

    "Catch him! This stupid cheater!"

    Before he finished speaking, several casino thugs with big muscles and fleshy faces pounced on him like hungry tigers.

    Chen Long, whose face was as golden as paper, was pinned to the ground by two strong men and could not move.

    A special lead-filled dice he had hidden in his sleeve rolled to the side, shining strangely under the light.

    The evidence is conclusive.

    The casino manager, a man with a hideous scar on his face, walked over with a sinister smile.

    He stepped heavily on the back of Chen Long's hand and crushed it with his toes.

    "Crack!"

    The soft sound of broken finger bones was drowned out by the din of the casino.

    "Ah!!"

    Chen Long howled like a killing pig.

    "Boy, you are very brave to dare to play tricks on the territory of our Vulture Gang." Steward Scar spat and said slowly, "According to our rules here, if you are caught out of a thousand, your hands will be chopped off!"

    The word "chop your hands" came out.

    Chen Long was so frightened that he burst into tears. He ignored the severe pain in his hands and kowtowed to the ground desperately, begging for mercy: "Hero, please forgive me! Master, please forgive me! I don't dare to do it anymore! I will return all the money I won to you, no, I will give you all the money I have!"

    However, Scar the Steward remained unmoved.

    He was already used to this kind of scene.

    A sharp ax was held high by a thug, and the sharp ax blade reflected a cold light under the light.

    The shadow of death instantly enveloped Chen Long.

    Under this extreme fear, he burst out with his last desire to survive. An idea flashed in his mind and he screamed:

    "Don't kill me! Don't kill me! My father is Chen An! Chen An from Fengyun Escort Bureau! He is someone you can't afford to offend! He is the savior of the Qin Hu family!"

    "Huh?"

    The axe, which was raised high, suddenly paused in the air.

    The entire noisy corner seemed to have been pressed on the pause button.

    The evil smile on Steward Scar's face froze, and a trace of surprise and fear flashed in his eyes.

    Fengyun Escort Bureau, Qin Hu!
